commit 1a9c563cb5592a315581938e5628b1ed9fdbad13
Author:     Geoff Lankow <geoff@darktrojan.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Aug 6 00:03:31 2026 +0000
Commit:     geoff@darktrojan.net <geoff@darktrojan.net>
CommitDate: Thu Aug 6 00:13:32 2026 +0000

    Bug 2061029 - Port bug 1977771: Update builders to clang 22. r=aleca
    
    The remaining "21"s are for things that haven't been updated upstream yet.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D316673

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
index 5d45955874a..9637783f2de 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/clang.yml
@@ -22,12 +22,12 @@ task-defaults:
 # mozilla-central for Firefox builds, except that the Android compiler-rt
 # pieces have been left out.
 
-linux64-clang-21:
-    description: "Clang 21 toolchain build"
+linux64-clang-22:
+    description: "Clang 22 toolchain build"
     attributes:
         local-toolchain: true
     treeherder:
-        symbol: TL(clang-21)
+        symbol: TL(clang-22)
     worker:
         max-run-time: 600
     run:
@@ -40,22 +40,22 @@ linux64-clang-21:
     fetches:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-cctools-port
-            - linux64-clang-21-raw
-            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-21
-            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-21
-            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-21
-            - win32-compiler-rt-21
-            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-            - win64-compiler-rt-21
+            - linux64-clang-22-raw
+            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
+            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-22
+            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
+            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-22
+            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-22
+            - win32-compiler-rt-22
+            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
+            - win64-compiler-rt-22
 
-win64-clang-21:
-    description: "Clang-cl 21 toolchain build"
+win64-clang-22:
+    description: "Clang-cl 22 toolchain build"
     attributes:
         local-toolchain: true
     treeherder:
-        symbol: TW64(clang-21)
+        symbol: TW64(clang-22)
     worker:
         max-run-time: 600
     run:
@@ -70,12 +70,12 @@ win64-clang-21:
     fetches:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-cctools-port
-            - win64-clang-21-raw
-            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-21
-            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-21
-            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-21
-            - win32-compiler-rt-21
-            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-            - win64-compiler-rt-21
+            - win64-clang-22-raw
+            - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
+            - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-22
+            - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
+            - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-22
+            - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-22
+            - win32-compiler-rt-22
+            - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
+            - win64-compiler-rt-22
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
index b9f2a3a13e6..e9091eaf265 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
@@ -11,13 +11,13 @@ kind-dependencies:
 
 reference-tasks:
     - linux64-7zz
-    - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
+    - linux64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
     - linux64-cargo-vet
     - linux64-cbindgen
     - linux64-cctools-port
-    - linux64-clang-21-profile
-    - linux64-clang-21-raw
     - linux64-clang-21-stage1
+    - linux64-clang-22-profile
+    - linux64-clang-22-raw
     - linux64-clang-mingw-x64
     - linux64-clang-mingw-x86
     - linux64-clang-tidy
@@ -41,8 +41,8 @@ reference-tasks:
     - linux64-pkgconf
     - linux64-python
     - linux64-rust
-    - linux64-rust-dev
     - linux64-rust-cross
+    - linux64-rust-dev
     - linux64-rust-macos
     - linux64-rust-macos-toolchain
     - linux64-rust-size
@@ -56,19 +56,16 @@ reference-tasks:
     - linux64-upx
     - linux64-winchecksec
     - linux64-wine
-    - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-21
+    - linux64-x64-compiler-rt-22
     - linux64-xar
-    - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
-    - macosx64-clang-21-profile
-    - macosx64-clang-21-raw
-    - macosx64-clang-21-stage2
+    - macosx64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
     - macosx64-fix-stacks
     - macosx64-grcov
     - macosx64-minidump-stackwalk
     - macosx64-node
     - macosx64-sdk
     - macosx64-sdk-toolchain
-    - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-21
+    - macosx64-x64-compiler-rt-22
     - mingw32-rust
     - node-modules
     - nsis
@@ -79,18 +76,19 @@ reference-tasks:
     - terser
     - vs
     - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-21
-    - win32-compiler-rt-21
+    - wasm32-wasi-compiler-rt-22
+    - win32-compiler-rt-22
     - win32-fix-stacks
     - win32-minidump-stackwalk
     - win32-node
     - win64-7zz
-    - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-21
+    - win64-aarch64-compiler-rt-22
     - win64-cbindgen
-    - win64-clang-21-profile
-    - win64-clang-21-raw
-    - win64-clang-21-stage2
+    - win64-clang-22-profile
+    - win64-clang-22-raw
+    - win64-clang-22-stage2
     - win64-cmake
-    - win64-compiler-rt-21
+    - win64-compiler-rt-22
     - win64-dump_syms
     - win64-grcov
     - win64-libxml2
@@ -104,9 +102,9 @@ reference-tasks:
     - win64-rust-size
     - win64-sccache
     - win64-winchecksec
+    - winappsdk-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
     - winappsdk-x86-pc-windows-msvc
     - winappsdk-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
-    - winappsdk-aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
